recipes.title: Classic French Roast Chicken with Herbs
recipes.description: Whole bird with thyme, rosemary, butter under skin, pan gravy.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and pat the 1.5 kg chicken dry inside and out with paper towels.
Finely chop 15g thyme and 10g rosemary leaves, then mix with 100g softened butter, 4 cloves minced garlic, 0.75 tsp salt, and 0.25 tsp black pepper until combined.
Gently lift the skin on the chicken breast and thighs, then spread half the herb butter evenly under the skin.
Rub the remaining herb butter all over the outside of the chicken, then season the cavity with 0.75 tsp salt and 0.25 tsp black pepper.
Stuff the cavity with 1 lemon halved, then tie the legs together with kitchen twine.
Place the chicken breast-side up in a roasting pan and roast at 200°C for 1 hour 15 minutes until the skin is golden and the thigh reaches 75°C internally.
Transfer the roasted chicken to a warm plate and rest uncovered for 10 minutes.
Place the roasting pan over medium heat on the stovetop, pour in 120 ml white wine, and scrape up all browned bits with a wooden spoon.
Add 250 ml chicken stock and simmer over medium heat for 3 minutes to combine.
Whisk 1 tbsp flour with 2 tbsp cold water to form a slurry, then whisk into the pan over medium heat and simmer for 2 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Strain the gravy through a fine sieve into a serving jug and season with remaining salt and pepper to taste.
Carve the rested chicken and serve on a platter with the warm herb gravy drizzled over.
